candidate.bug_signature: autouse fixtures running in unittest.skip classes
candidate.repro_summary: Create a unittest.TestCase decorated with @unittest.skip. Define an autouse fixture in it that raises an error. Running pytest will fail with the error instead of skipping the class.
candidate.bad_behavior: Autouse fixtures run even when the class is decorated with @unittest.skip.
candidate.expected_behavior: The class should be skipped and the autouse fixtures should not execute.
candidate.preserved_behavior: Normal fixtures should still work, and @unittest.skipIf(False) should execute the fixtures.
edge_cases: @unittest.skipIf with False condition should still run the fixture
